evidence: Adds ci/test/wrap-fd-limit.sh and updates macOS CI scripts (ci/test/00_setup_env_mac_native.sh, ci/test/03_test_script.sh) to simulate low-FD environments in PR CI.
rationale: Prevents recurring file descriptor regressions on platforms constrained by FD_SETSIZE by adding test FD limits to per-PR CI. The author notes that NetBSD regressions recurred in PR #31537, PR #36078, and PR #35037 because NetBSD only runs in nightly CI.
